title: Section switcher with a wheel commit ring
summary: The document never scrolls: GSAP Observer sums wheel delta magnitudes into a `role="progressbar"` ring that commits one step at 500, drains after 1 s idle, resets on reversal and locks 900 ms after a commit; swipe > 55 px, arrow / Page / Home / End keys and prev / next reach every panel, inactive panels `inert`, one live-region announcement per change, instant swap (wheel still live) under reduced motion, `__awards.scrollTo` routed to panels
variants: wheel commit ring: |deltaY| summed to 500, idle rollback after 1 s, 900 ms lock (this, default)
stepped wheel: one step per input past |deltaY| 18 with a 760 ms lock, no ring
sectioned native scroll: sticky stages over a scrolling document when panels carry long copy
